site.name: Carbon Think
site.title: Carbon Think — Climate Resilience for Sudan
site.description: Carbon Think is a Sudanese social enterprise unlocking climate finance and carbon markets, building local capacity, and generating the evidence that drives climate investment in Sudan.

hero.title: Climate resilience, *led by* Sudanese communities.
hero.lead: We connect Sudanese communities, cooperatives and startups to climate finance and carbon markets, build their technical capacity, and generate the data needed to design fundable projects — while safeguarding ecosystems and indigenous practices.

Pillars: finance & markets, training, research & data
Sudan-focused Climate Catalytic Fund in development

about.heading: A bridge between Sudan's frontline communities and the world's climate capital.
paragraphs: Carbon Think is a social enterprise helping Sudanese communities, cooperatives and startups build climate resilience. We close the gap between local knowledge and international finance — turning community-led ideas into bankable, standards-compliant projects.
Our work protects ecosystems and honours the indigenous practices that have sustained Sudan's land for generations.
about.mission: To enable Sudanese communities to build climate resilience by unlocking finance and markets, strengthening local capacity, and generating the evidence that drives investment.
about.vision: A Sudan where climate-vulnerable communities lead and benefit from their own resilience and low-carbon development.

problem.heading: Access to finance is one of the greatest barriers to climate resilience in Sudan.

cards.title: No direct access to the Green Climate Fund
cards.text: Sudan has no accredited Direct Access Entity (DAE) to the GCF — the largest dedicated climate fund under the UNFCCC. Communities and organisations face complex bureaucratic obstacles to securing vital climate finance.

cards.title: Limited awareness & technical capacity
cards.text: Many local stakeholders lack awareness of available climate funding mechanisms and the technical capacity to develop fundable, climate-resilient projects that meet international standards.

cards.title: Livelihoods left exposed
cards.text: Grassroots organisations, cooperatives and entrepreneurs lack the training, finance and market linkages needed to climate-proof their livelihoods.

pillars.heading: Three pillars. One resilient Sudan.
pillars.intro: We work across the full journey — from first idea to funded, verified, market-ready project.

items.title: Access to funds & markets
items.text: Blended finance — grants, concessional loans and guarantees — through a Sudan-focused Climate Catalytic Fund, plus market access through high-quality voluntary carbon credits (VERs).

items.title: Guidance & training
items.text: Incubators, hackathons and technical assistance that build a pipeline of climate-resilient businesses and community-led projects ready for investment.

items.title: Research & data
items.text: Evidence on climate vulnerability, adaptation needs and carbon market opportunities in Sudan — the foundation every fundable project needs.

fund.heading: The Sudan Climate Catalytic Fund
fund.text: We are establishing a Climate Catalytic Fund to support communities and startups with blended finance. By layering grants, concessional loans and guarantees, the Fund absorbs early risk so local and international investors can follow.

points.label: How it works
points.value: Blended, catalytic capital matched to project stage

points.label: Why it matters
points.value: Fills the gap left by the absence of a Sudanese GCF DAE

carbon.heading: Reviving Sudan's carbon market prospects.
carbon.intro: We develop projects under recognised standards and link them to buyers — so high-integrity carbon finance flows back to the communities doing the work.

steps.title: Identify & design
steps.text: Work with communities and project developers to identify nature-based and low-carbon opportunities.

steps.title: Certify
steps.text: Develop projects under Gold Standard, Verra (VCS) and Puro.Earth methodologies.

steps.title: Verify
steps.text: Coordinate independent project verifiers to ensure integrity and transparency.

steps.title: Connect to buyers
steps.text: Link high-quality VERs to responsible buyers, with benefits shared with communities.

carbon.ctaText: **Buying or developing carbon credits?** Talk to our carbon markets team.

research.heading: Research & awareness tools
research.intro: We produce research and awareness tools on climate finance and resilience — making evidence accessible to communities, policymakers and investors.

items.title: Carbon market opportunities in Sudan
